body.en: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pumps-speed-torque-d_1114.html HBT80-16 vs electric 60 concrete pump HBT80-16 lists 110 kW, 50 m³/h and a single height line. HBT80-16 and Electric 60 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Electric 60 lists 90 kW, 40 m³/h, outlet pressure 35 MPa and three stone rows, including fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. Where HBT80-16 and Electric 60 list different values Theoretical output: HBT80-16 lists 50 m³/h; Electric 60 lists 40 m³/h. These are listed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. Cells that exist on only one of these pumps Electric 60 lists cells that HBT80-16 does not: Max. outlet pressure 35 MPa; Hopper capacity 0.7 m³; Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 200 m / 600 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 150 m / 450 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m. How to read the two pages without merging them Open /en/products/hbt80-16-concrete-pump/ for HBT80-16 and /en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric 60. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. Does HBT80-16 list the same motor power as Electric 60? Electric 60 lists 90 kW. Does HBT80-16 list the same theoretical output as Electric 60? Electric 60 lists 40 m³/h. No. HBT80-16 lists 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm. Why is model line missing on Electric 60? HBT80-16 lists HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
body.zh: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pumps-speed-torque-d_1114.htmlHBT80-16和电动60的区别HBT80-16 印 110 kW、50 m³/h 和单独的高度行。HBT80-16 和电动60是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、出口压力 35 MPa 和三行石子距离，其中细石为 200 m / 600 m。HBT80-16和电动60哪些数值不同理论输送量：HBT80-16印 50 m³/h；电动60印 40 m³/h。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。HBT80-16有、电动60没有的行：型号行 HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110；泵送压力 40 MPa；水平输送距离 120 m；输送高度 360 m；最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。HBT80-16 的电机千瓦更高，并不能抄走电动60细石行上的 600 m。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。不一样。电动60印 90 kW。HBT80-16和电动60的理论输送量一样吗？电动60印 40 m³/h。HBT80-16印 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm。为什么电动60没有型号行？HBT80-16印的是 HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。

body.en: HBT80-16 vs Electric 60 Concrete Pump Electric 60 lists 90 kW, 40 m³/h and three stone rows. Motor power: HBT80-16 lists 110 kW; Electric 60 lists 90 kW. Dimensions: HBT80-16 lists 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm; Electric 60 lists 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. HBT80-16 lists cells that Electric 60 does not: Model line HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110; Pumping pressure 40 MPa; Horizontal conveying distance 120 m; Delivery height 360 m; Max. aggregate size 4 cm and below. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. A higher motor kilowatt on HBT80-16 does not copy Electric 60's 600 m fine-stone line. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price. question.en: Does HBT80-16 list the same motor power as Electric 60?
question.zh: HBT80-16和电动60的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT80-16 lists 110 kW. Electric 60 lists 90 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT80-16印 110 kW。电动60印 90 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does HBT80-16 list the same theoretical output as Electric 60?
question.zh: HBT80-16和电动60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT80-16 lists 50 m³/h. Electric 60 lists 40 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT80-16印 50 m³/h。电动60印 40 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does HBT80-16 list the same dimensions as Electric 60?
question.zh: HBT80-16和电动60的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. HBT80-16 lists 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm. Electric 60 lists 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT80-16印 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm。电动60印 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is model line missing on Electric 60?
question.zh: 为什么电动60没有型号行？

answer.en: The Electric 60 page does not list that label. HBT80-16 lists HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动60这一页没有印这个标题。HBT80-16印的是 HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
